name: ContactSheetGallery
job: Show a photo set as negatives on a glowing light table; a loupe follows the pointer to inspect frames, and picking one circles it in china marker and lifts it through the loupe into a large print
visitor_action: move the pointer to look through the loupe; click/tap a frame; arrow keys move between frames; Esc closes the large view; swipe between photos in the large view
mobile: 3-column sheet, loupe follows horizontal drags, tap opens full-width view, swipe between photos
motion: loupe settles onto the sheet on entry and springs after the pointer with real magnification and barrel distortion; on pick a china-marker circle draws, then the print lifts through the loupe: a circular mask expands while the negative develops into a positive; the table light breathes slowly (reduced-motion: loupe rests statically on the first picked frame, circles pre-drawn, instant open, positive shown)

checks.render: unverified (shots disabled 2026-11-23, Guy token saving; modules transform clean on dev server)
checks.craft: unverified (no shots this pass; independent review pending)

art_direction: Lightbox: near-black darkroom, a glowing milky light table that bleeds off the card edges, amber color-negative frames with luminous sprocket holes and mono edge data, china-marker red pick circles, a glass-and-metal loupe with lens distortion as the hero object; Space Grotesk display, tabular mono data
